verdict.rationale: Spend caps and usage alerts are a fair question for a hosted backend platform like Supabase, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of spend caps, billing limits, or usage alerts. Logs and Advisors are adjacent observability features and do not cap spend or alert on usage.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spend caps or usage alerts so a runaway query or traffic spike cannot produce a surprise bill
